claude.result:
`game.html` is complete — a single self-contained 74KB file at `./game.html` in the working directory, with the temporary verification script removed so nothing else was created.

**What's in it** (all 13 systems, in the required priority order):

- **Core loop** — one state object, mulberry32 PRNG stored in state (`rngState`), seed 1337 editable in the header, no `Math.random` anywhere. Turn order is fixed and documented in a comment above `endTurn()`: storm → production (in chain order) → needs → settlers → caravan → events → overflow/end-check.
- **Map** — 8×8 seeded terrain (ash/rock/water/vent/ruins, minimum counts guaranteed), click-to-build with terrain requirements, adjacency bonuses (condenser +30%/water, forge +25%/vent, greenhouse +20%/water, sifter +10%/ash) shown in tooltips with per-tile counts.
- **Economy** — full chains with intermediates: mine→ore→forge(+power)→metal, sifter→soil→greenhouse(+water)→food, workshop→parts, geo→power. Storage caps with logged overflow, plus a spill rule when storage buildings are damaged or demolished.
- **Population/needs** — named colonists with one of 4 jobs, skill 1–5 (grows with matched work), fatigue, morale. Shortages, overcrowding, and clinics all move morale; at zero morale a colonist refuses to work for one turn, then leaves — visible and recoverable.
- **Research** — 10 nodes with prereqs, scrip/parts costs, locked/available/done states; effects hit yields, water use, storm damage, storage, and trade.
- **Events** — 12-event weighted deck with per-event cooldowns; 5 events offer 2–3 choice modals (refugees, medic, ashlung, wanderer, festival) with genuinely different state-changing tradeoffs.
- **Trade** — caravan every ~6 turns with limited stock; prices = base × drifting world demand × your-stockpile factor, improved by a staffed Bazaar and Guild Contracts.
- **Storms** — every 7 turns, severity scales with turn; damage disables buildings until repaired (parts + skipped output + worker fatigue); windbreaks and two research nodes mitigate; water use spikes ×1.5.
- **Save/Load** — Dev tab textarea export/import, with validation that rejects bad JSON, wrong shapes, unknown buildings/research, and corrupt pending events.
- **End conditions** — win at turn 60 with pop ≥ 12 and needs met; lose at pop 0 or a failed turn-60 review; both show a scored breakdown (population, research, stockpile, turns, victory bonus).
- **UI** — 6 tabs (keys 1–6, Space ends turn), custom hover/tap tooltips explaining every number including modifier provenance, scrolling turn-stamped log, fits 360px (8 tiles × 40px), and no color-only state (glyphs, "LOW" badges, text statuses everywhere).
- **Dev panel** — "Run Tests" (25 assertions over real invariants: caps, negatives, roster integrity, prereqs, save/load hash round-trip, storm mitigation monotonicity, determinism) and "Run Benchmark" (headless 200-turn greedy-policy sim printing a state hash plus stats; same seed → identical hash).

**One caveat to be upfront about:** I could not execute the file here — every interpreter invocation (`node`/`python`) required an approval this session couldn't grant, and my one scratch attempt (`ash_verify.mjs`) was deleted after the sandbox blocked running it. So verification was a full line-by-line read of the assembled file (all 1,266 lines) rather than a live run; during that review I fixed the issues I found (missing `force` flag on `endTurn`, save-validation gaps, cap-shrink spillage). When you open it, please click **Dev → Run Tests** first — that's the intended smoke test, and it runs entirely on scratch states without touching your game.
